claims.evidence: I will kill them. I will cook them. I will serve them. Thanks, Dave.

claims.evidence: MINTROCKET has announced DAVE THE DIVER‘s final downloadable content pack—a Subnautica 2-themed expansion in partnership …

claims.claim: Rock Paper Shotgun published a piece headlined: Dave the Diver is wrapping up its DLC plans with an aquatically appropriate Subnautica 2 collab
claims.evidence: I am not a huge fan of collaboration DLCs, mostly because my curmudgeonly self can only see them as attempts at multiple companies trying to profit off of one another's things. But I do have to admit that yes, the just announced collab between Dave the Diver and Subnautica 2 does make total sense. Certainly more sense than the Godzilla one from a couple of years back. Read more

claims.claim: Nintendo Life published a piece headlined: Dave The Diver's Final DLC Is The Perfect Crossover
claims.evidence: Submerging next year. After years of content updates and DLC expansions, Mintrocket has announced that the final wave of DLC for Dave the Diver will launch in ' Early 2027 ', and it's a crossover that feels like it was always meant to be. Dave will be teaming up with Subnautica 2 in the free expansion, adding the ocean moon Proteus into the gameplay loop, complete with its fair share of alien crea

claims.claim: Mintrocket has announced Dave the Diver's final DLC, a Subnautica 2 Content Pack made with Unknown Worlds Entertainment, launching free of charge in early 2027.
claims.evidence: Gematsu: final DLC pack, Subnautica 2-themed, free of charge in early 2027.

claims.claim: Players explore the waters of Proteus, with Dave and Bancho travelling between dimensions to find new creatures, resources and recipes while facing a Leviathan.
Dave the Diver is available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, Switch 2, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Switch, PC, iOS and Android.
Mintrocket studio director Jaeho Hwang said working with the Subnautica 2 team let the studio bring something new to the game.
claims.evidence: Rock Paper Shotgun quotes Hwang's statement.
claims.quote: Both games are set underwater, but Subnautica has such a distinct approach to underwater exploration

claims.claim: Hwang said a Subnautica collaboration is something players had been requesting for a long time.
claims.evidence: Gematsu quotes Hwang's press release statement.

claims.claim: Subnautica 2 creative director Anthony Gallegos called the expansion a love letter to both games.
claims.quote: the expansion is a love letter to both Dave the Diver and the Subnautica universe

claims.claim: The reveal trailer shows Dave going through a portal to Subnautica 2's ocean moon and meeting its Leviathan.
claims.evidence: Rock Paper Shotgun describes the trailer.

claims.claim: There is no word on Dave appearing in Subnautica 2, which is still in early access.
claims.evidence: Rock Paper Shotgun: no word if Dave will be making a counter appearance; the latter is still in early access.

claims.claim: Dave the Diver has had crossover DLC before, including one with Godzilla.
claims.evidence: Rock Paper Shotgun mentions the earlier Godzilla collaboration.

claims.claim: Rock Paper Shotgun says details of the collaboration are slim beyond the trailer.
claims.evidence: RPS: details are a touch slim on the collab.
